Coordinator: Long shift, any word from the relief planner. I am sorry the handoff has been slow, and I am still trying to keep every pet plan steady for Aurelia Skyways.  
Planner: I have the updated notes from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. <<FACT F019>> The care review is clear, and the lounge plan should stay simple for the traveler.  
Coordinator: Thank you, that helps, and I will keep the next desk brief so no one feels rushed.  
Handler: I checked the crate notes, water needs, and comfort cues, and Teddy is calm. The shared duty here is to keep each animal safe without adding stress to the family.  
Coordinator: I appreciate that, and I will pass along the reminder with care. <<FACT F018>> We can keep the relief stop easy to find and reduce confusion for the traveler.  
Planner: Good, and I will keep the record aligned with the booking file so nothing gets missed.  
Coordinator: Thanks, I know the service is better when we work as one team.
